sv.title: KI-barometern: Hushållen allt deppigare
sv.summary: Barometerindikatorn, som sammanfattar läget i svensk ekonomi, sjönk till 104,7 i november från 107,4 i oktober. Det framgår av Konjunkturinstitutets konjunkturbarometer.

en.title: KI barometer: Households increasingly gloomy
en.summary: The barometer indicator, which summarises the state of the Swedish economy, fell to 104.7 in November from 107.4 in October. This is according to the National Institute of Economic Research's business barometer.
